subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed through plugin-hook metadata only, untrusted per-turn prompt context, or persisted session metadata?
rationale: The extraction itself is bounded, but the requested click id is ad-attribution data and the issue asks for model/session visibility, so automation should not choose the exposure and retention boundary.

options.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
options.body: Expose CTWA fields to opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook metadata so a Conversions API plugin can consume them without putting click ids in the model prompt by default.

options.title: Untrusted Prompt Context
options.body: Expose selected CTWA fields as untrusted structured context and accept that the model can see them during that turn.

options.title: Persist Session Attribution
options.body: Store first-touch CTWA attribution on session state after defining retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
recommendation.body: Expose CTWA fields to opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook metadata so a Conversions API plugin can consume them without putting click ids in the model prompt by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is ownership of the session metadata path and adjacent product/security boundary work.
